description: SNR, SINAD, THD and ENOB of a tone, and SFDR with its spurs, from one windowed spectrum (conventions: Tone metrics, Spurs and SFDR).

cases.source: closed form: on-bin tones under the default Blackman-Harris window each fill 7 bins, all inside their +-4 groups, which by Parseval hold exactly the tone's power
closed form: the complex_hann_aliased input with the -24 Hz tone named; harmonics 2 and 3 alias to 16 and -8 Hz, where no tone's bins are
closed form: for complex input +fs/2 aliases to the -fs/2 bin, where the 0.5 tone is
closed form: the real_rectangular input with the Nyquist tone (power 0.003^2) named at fs/2; its group 31-32 holds only that bin's power
closed form: on-bin tones, rectangular window; S = 1/2, H = (0.1^2 + 0.05^2)/2, N = 0.02^2/2 + 0.01^2/2 + 0.003^2 (Nyquist), DC 0.25^2
closed form: as real_rectangular, with num_harmonics 0 the harmonics are noise and THD is -inf
closed form: on-bin tones with the rectangular window fill one bin, so half-width 0 changes nothing
closed form: on-bin tones, Hann fills k-1 … k+1, all inside the +-2 groups; centroid of the symmetric group is bin 10 = 78.125 Hz
closed form: complex on-bin tones, power |A|^2; harmonics 2 and 3 of 20 Hz alias to -24 and -4 Hz
closed form: the fundamental named at 3 Hz; the 12 Hz spur is noise, so SNR is 10 log10(0.005/0.125)
closed form: Hann puts 2/3 of an on-bin tone in its own bin and 1/6 in each neighbour; with half-width 0 the neighbours are noise
at least two samples required
samples must be finite
finite samples whose power overflows: the spectrum must be finite
a constant has power only at DC; every other bin is rounding error, set to zero
the DC group takes all 33 bins, none is left for the fundamental
|fundamental| <= sample_rate/2 required
sample_rate must be positive
num_harmonics >= 0 required
width >= 0 required
the bin nearest 1 Hz is in the DC group (bins 0 and 1)
|fundamental| <= sample_rate/2 required
a real input's fundamental must be >= 0
the fundamental must be finite
all zeros: no signal power at the fundamental
closed form: the tone_metrics real_rectangular input; spurs strongest first, the harmonics at 10 and 15 Hz among them
closed form: the tone_metrics complex_hann_aliased input; each spur's three Hann bins lie in its group, so its centroid is its bin
closed form: the carrier named at 3 Hz is 14 dB below the 12 Hz spur, so SFDR is negative
by hand: 5 one-sided bins; with half-width 1 DC takes bins 0-1 and the 3 Hz carrier 2-4, so no bin is left for a spur
closed form: the tone_metrics default_window input; spurs strongest first, each a whole 7-bin Blackman-Harris group, symmetric so its centroid is its bin
num_spurs >= 1 required
the fundamental is in the DC group
at least two samples required
the kaiser window needs beta
